compliance.title: Compliance-aware sourcing for EU-facing exports.
compliance.copy: The EU and India concluded Free Trade Agreement negotiations on 27 January 2026. We track this development without overclaiming: the published text is still subject to legal revision, signature, and each side's internal entry-into-force procedures.
compliance.statusTitle: Negotiations concluded, legal entry into force still matters.
compliance.statusCopy: The agreement is positioned as the largest trade agreement concluded by either side and is expected to reduce tariffs on more than 96% of EU goods exports. For import and export planning, we still treat rules of origin, customs facilitation, SPS, technical barriers to trade, and product-specific obligations as mandatory checks.

statusItems.concluded: FTA negotiations concluded on 27 January 2026 after the 2022 relaunch.
statusItems.informational: Commission-published legal texts remain informational until signature and internal procedures are complete.
statusItems.indiaRelease: India's official release highlights preferential access for more than 99% of Indian exports by trade value to the EU.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: This Privacy Policy provides information on the processing of personal data in connection with the Shoppingmart Exports website. It applies to website access, information stored in the visitor's browser, business enquiries, and communications initiated by email or WhatsApp.

controller.title: Controller and contact
controller.copy: Shoppingmart Exports determines the purposes and means of the processing described in this Privacy Policy and is therefore the controller within the meaning of Article 4(7) GDPR. Enquiries concerning data protection and the exercise of data-subject rights may be addressed to:

scope.title: Scope of this Privacy Policy
scope.copy: This Privacy Policy applies exclusively to the processing operations described below. Where a visitor follows a link to an external service, the terms and privacy information of the respective provider additionally apply.

delivery.title: Website delivery and server log data
delivery.copy: When the website is requested, the hosting and delivery infrastructure may process technical connection data required to deliver and secure the website. Such data may include the IP address, date and time of access, requested resource, referrer information transmitted by the browser, browser type, operating system and response status. Recipients are the hosting and technical service providers engaged for website delivery and security.
delivery.basis: Processing is carried out pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interests consist of providing a functional and secure website, preventing misuse and maintaining technical stability.

storage.title: Local storage in the visitor's browser
storage.copy: The website uses the browser's local-storage facility. The information is stored on the visitor's device and may be read by the website on subsequent visits.
storage.language: Language preference: the selected website language is stored to retain the visitor's choice.
storage.enquiry: Quotation form: entries made in the quotation form—including name, email address, company, contact details, market, category, shipment volume, message and confirmation status—may be stored locally to retain the draft and its processing status. The stored record may also contain a timestamp, request identifier, browser language and user-agent information.
storage.control: The visitor may remove this information through the browser controls for deleting site data. Processing serves the requested form functionality and preparation of a potential business enquiry pursuant to Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.

contact.title: Contact by email and business enquiries
contact.copy: The email link opens the visitor's locally configured email application. Personal data is transmitted to Shoppingmart Exports only where the visitor independently sends an email. The data processed may include sender and contact details, message content, attachments and communication metadata. It is used to respond to and administer the enquiry.
contact.basis: Where communication concerns a quotation, contract negotiations or steps requested before entering into a contract, processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. General business correspondence is processed pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, based on the legitimate interest in responding to and documenting business communications. Statutory retention obligations are based on Article 6(1)(c) GDPR where applicable.

whatsapp.title: Communication via WhatsApp
whatsapp.activation: The website contains a link to a WhatsApp chat with Shoppingmart Exports. No WhatsApp software development kit, tracking pixel or embedded social-media content is loaded by this website. A connection to WhatsApp is initiated only when the visitor activates the link.
whatsapp.data: Upon activation, WhatsApp may process technical connection and account data in accordance with its own terms. If the visitor sends a message, Shoppingmart Exports processes the sender's telephone number, profile information made available by the sender, message content, attachments and communication metadata for the purpose of responding to and administering the enquiry.
whatsapp.basis: Processing of quotation and pre-contractual enquiries is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Other business correspondence is processed pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, based on the legitimate interest in maintaining efficient business communications through a channel selected by the visitor.
whatsapp.recipient: WhatsApp is an independent provider. For users in the European Region, the service is provided by WhatsApp Ireland Limited, Merrion Road, Dublin 4, D04 X2K5, Ireland. WhatsApp and other Meta companies process data under their own responsibility and in accordance with their own privacy terms.
whatsapp.transfer: WhatsApp states that information is processed globally and may be transferred to the United States and other countries outside the European Economic Area. The applicable safeguards and transfer mechanisms are described in WhatsApp's privacy information.
whatsapp.voluntary: Use of WhatsApp is voluntary. Visitors may contact Shoppingmart Exports without using WhatsApp by sending an email to
whatsapp.providerPolicy: WhatsApp Privacy Policy for the European Region

external.title: External links and LinkedIn
external.copy: The website contains links to third-party services, including LinkedIn and WhatsApp. No content from these providers is embedded in the website. Data is transmitted to the respective provider only after the visitor activates an external link. The subsequent processing is governed by that provider's privacy information.

tracking.title: Cookies, analytics and marketing technologies
tracking.copy: The website does not set advertising cookies and does not integrate an analytics platform, advertising network, Meta Pixel or comparable cross-site tracking technology. The browser local-storage operations described in section 4 are used for functional purposes and not for behavioural advertising or profiling.

retention.title: Retention and erasure
retention.local: Information stored in browser local storage remains on the visitor's device until it is removed through the browser's site-data controls, overwritten by later use or deleted by browser configuration. Shoppingmart Exports cannot remotely retrieve or erase data that has not left the visitor's device.
retention.communication: Email and WhatsApp correspondence is retained only for as long as necessary to respond to the enquiry, conduct or prepare the business relationship, establish or defend legal claims, and comply with applicable commercial, tax and record-keeping obligations. Upon expiry of the relevant purpose and mandatory retention periods, the data is erased or restricted from further operational use.

rights.title: Rights of data subjects
rights.copy: Subject to the statutory requirements, data subjects have the right of access under Article 15 GDPR, rectification under Article 16 GDPR, erasure under Article 17 GDPR, restriction of processing under Article 18 GDPR, data portability under Article 20 GDPR and objection under Article 21 GDPR. Where processing is based on consent, consent may be withdrawn at any time with effect for the future under Article 7(3) GDPR.
rights.contact: Requests concerning these rights may be submitted to the contact address stated in section 1. Identity verification may be required where reasonably necessary to protect personal data against unauthorised disclosure.
rights.complaint: Data subjects also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority pursuant to Article 77 GDPR, in particular in the Member State of their habitual residence, place of work or place of the alleged infringement.

security.title: Security of processing
security.copy: Appropriate technical and organisational measures are applied having regard to the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing and the risks to data subjects. Internet communications cannot, however, be guaranteed to be completely secure. Visitors should not transmit special-category data or confidential information through an ordinary enquiry unless this is necessary and an appropriate communication channel has been agreed.

changes.title: Amendments to this Privacy Policy
changes.copy: This Privacy Policy reflects the processing activities in effect on the version date stated above. It may be amended where processing purposes, data categories, recipients, service providers, retention periods, legal requirements or technical systems change. The version date identifies the applicable revision.

hero.title: Build your dream home, without sourcing stress.
hero.copy: For families building or renovating abroad, Shoppingmart Exports connects Indian materials, craftsmanship, and export coordination into one practical sourcing journey.

intro.title: Global buyers do not purchase one product. They build a supply path.
intro.copy: In real export business, sourcing is a managed process: understanding the requirement, comparing suppliers, checking practical specifications, planning packing, and preparing documents before the shipment moves. We bring that same disciplined approach to custom product discovery from India.

dreamHome.title: A home abroad can still feel rooted, warm, and unmistakably yours.
dreamHome.copyOne: The story often starts with one question: "Can I bring the look and feeling of India into my new home?" The answer is yes, if the sourcing is handled as a complete project instead of scattered shopping.
dreamHome.copyTwo: We help you think through the visible surfaces, the daily-use rooms, the spiritual corner, the decor details, and the export movement behind it. You focus on the home you want to live in. Our export team handles the sourcing conversation from India.

solutions.title: Not a fixed catalog. A curated home sourcing conversation.
solutions.copy: These examples show the direction. The real solution can be broader, mixed, and tailored around your destination, quantity, finish level, and installation planning.
